ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the distal lobes to low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the medial and peduncle regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the outer lateral lobes; a central low-intensity black region extends from the peduncle into the fluke center; interior boundaries of the white regions feature dense, stochastic black stippling and mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 115 degrees; notch depth is roughly 5% of the total vertical height of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire continuous boundary; peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 5 to 15 pixels; a distinct deeper indentation is located on the distal third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature along the trailing edge, transitioning into acute, slightly uplifted lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular yellowish-white pixel clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; approximately 6-8 clusters on the left tip and 3-5 on the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, dark, unaligned linear pixel streaks visible on the right white lobe, breaking the high-intensity background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active barnacle colonization on distal lobe tips; irregular jagged trailing edge indicates minor historical physical trauma or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive black stippling 'spray' pattern concentrated on the interior-medial margins of the white pigmentation zones.
